title: Vertical rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop by starting with an arc from (0.0, 0.0009) to (0.0003, 0.0003) and ending at (0.0009, 0.0). Continue with a line from (0.0009, 0.0) to (0.0111, 0.0). Draw another arc from (0.0111, 0.0) to (0.0117, 0.0003) and end at (0.012, 0.0009). Follow with a line from (0.012, 0.0009) to (0.012, 0.0111). Draw an arc from (0.012, 0.0111) to (0.0117, 0.0117) and end at (0.0111, 0.012). Add a line from (0.0111, 0.012) to (0.0009, 0.012). Draw an arc from (0.0009, 0.012) to (0.0003, 0.0117) and end at (0.0, 0.0111). Complete the loop with a line from (0.0, 0.0111) to (0.0, 0.0009). For the second loop, draw a line from (0.0009, 0.0009) to (0.0111, 0.0009). Add a line from (0.0111, 0.0009) to (0.0111, 0.0111). Draw a line from (0.0111, 0.0111) to (0.0009, 0.0111). Finish with a line from (0.0009, 0.0111) to (0.0009, 0.0009). Scale the entire sketch using a factor of 0.012. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by applying no rotation and no translation. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the vertical rod with a cylindrical top and rectangular base are 0.012 units in length, 0.012 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Define the outer loop
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0009).threePointArc((0.0003, 0.0003), (0.0009, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0111, 0.0).threePointArc((0.0117, 0.0003), (0.012, 0.0009))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.012, 0.0111).threePointArc((0.0117, 0.0117), (0.0111, 0.012))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0009, 0.012).threePointArc((0.0003, 0.0117), (0.0, 0.0111))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Define the inner loop
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0009, 0.0009).lineTo(0.0111, 0.0009)
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0111, 0.0111).lineTo(0.0009, 0.0111)
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Define the sketch

     .lineTo(0.012, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.012, 0.012) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.012) \
     .close() \
     .moveTo(0.0012, 0.0012) \
     .lineTo(0.0108, 0.0012) \
     .lineTo(0.0108, 0.0108) \
     .lineTo(0.0012, 0.0108) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch

import cadquery as cq

# Outer dimensions
outer_size = 0.012
wall = 0.002
height = 0.75

# Create hollow square tube
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(outer_size, outer_size)
    .rect(outer_size - 2 * wall, outer_size - 2 * wall)
    .extrude(height)
)
